tool_plan.objective: Generate representative Chrome cache content and preserve the Chrome cache folder for ChromeCacheView listing, metadata review, and export testing.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Launches Chromium with a profile that can create Chrome cache data.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Loads distinct web resources that produce cached responses.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observes visible controls and available finite choices before exercising them.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Creates search or form-request cache entries from typed input.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Commits visible interactions and loads linked or result content.

required_actions.name: browser.select_option
required_actions.why: Exercises meaningful finite page variants that can return different cached resources.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveals lazy-loaded content and associated cached resources.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserves a visible representation of content associated with generated cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Closes Chromium to flush pending cache data for collection.

completion.detail: Complete after Chromium has been closed and the preserved browser profile contains chromium.cache.cache_data generated during the browsing session.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chromium using the designated profile. Use browser.goto with relevant run-provided runtime resources, favoring pages with visible, cacheable content and interactions. On each page, use browser.get_clickables to inspect currently visible controls; use browser.smart_type where an available search or form field can submit a request, then use browser.smart_click to load visible links or results. Use browser.select_option only for visible meaningful variants. Use browser.scroll to reveal lazy-loaded visible content, then re-run browser.get_clickables as needed in a bounded observe -> reveal -> re-observe loop. Capture browser.screenshot after representative content is loaded. Visit a few distinct available runtime targets or page states so that documents, images, scripts, styles, result pages, and lazy-loaded resources can populate chromium.cache.cache_data. Close Chromium last to flush pending cache data while preserving the profile folder. Reason guidance: state the current page/context and the cache-producing effect of each action, such as loading content-rich resources, submitting a visible search, opening a visible result, selecting a page variant, or revealing
